verdict.rationale: Goodwin is a law firm whose Founders Workbench offers free document generators and calculators. A sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data is a software/API axis that does not fit this kind of legal-services product. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, so nothing shows Goodwin ships such a capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
